description: This Java class defines custom assertion methods for testing various Eclipse Ditto data structures such as JsonField, DittoRuntimeException, and DittoHeaders. It extends the assertion framework to add project-specific assertions for use in testing.

classes.name: DittoBaseAssertions
classes.description: A utility class providing custom assertion methods for Ditto JSON fields, exceptions, and headers to facilitate testing.

methods.name: assertThat(final JsonField jsonField)
methods.description: Creates an assertion object for a JsonField.

methods.name: assertThat(final DittoRuntimeException dittoRuntimeException)
methods.description: Creates an assertion object for a DittoRuntimeException.

methods.name: assertThat(final DittoHeaders dittoHeaders)
methods.description: Creates an assertion object for DittoHeaders.
